I told him that's not my concern AC not working. Then he offered me the standard room. I take that but after some time I found there was no running water in the tap I complain to the reception personal. He told me that "yesterday we forgot to switch on the water pump so you had to adjust" but I tell him "I am not going to take that room". After some time he gave me another room and told me the last room I have.
I take the room and found that the bathroom was smelling very bad. The linen of the bed was filthy and dirty.
Somehow I manage and  check out in the evening to find another good hotel.
